title: Work chain at the right boundary
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean work-tape symbols, let $w$ be a finite Boolean input, and let $t,T\in\mathbb{N}$ with $t\le T$. For every work-tape index $\tau$, the work-chain value at position $T$ after $t$ steps equals the symbol scanned by tape $\tau$ at that time.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
